answer: Each identity locks a 90-credit bond in a glacier vault and tends one vine row at an oasis. Work melts 10 credits back per epoch; idleness burns 10, and nine idle epochs void it. Auditors check each vine row against the oasis ledger: no growth or a reused receipt counts as idle. A rented-vine ring fails: a borrowed receipt is signed to its owner's row. A thousand idle fakes bleed 10,000 per epoch. An honest agent locks 90 once and gets it back.
